name: Auralis
tagline: A virtual doctor avatar that holds a video consultation, reads your emotions and writes a report.

awards: [MLH] Best AI Application Built with Cloudflare

problem: Medical consultations are hard to access and often lack empathy.
solution: A lip-synced 3D doctor avatar talks with the patient by voice, detects emotion and estimated age from the webcam, adapts its responses, and exports a structured summary and PDF report.
demo_moment: Team-described: video-call the avatar and receive a professional report at the end.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best AI Application Built with Cloudflare” among 82 submissions.
Combines a 3D avatar, emotion detection and voice in one call.

lessons: An avatar demo wins attention; medical claims need clear limits.
